description: Synthetic sesslint.scan parity: module constants, aggregate_scan views, SessionLink wire shape, rollout_uuid, looks_pathy, and documented minimize_path and threshold gaps.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-scan-minimize-path: FileResult.to_dict, WorstFileRow.to_dict, ScanReport.to_dict, scan_single_file, scan_path, and reconcile paths call sesslint.report.minimize_path in Python. Rust stops with sesslint.report.minimize_path is not available and does not return formatted findings or scan reports.
GAP-scan-validate-thresholds: scan_bytes and scan_path call sesslint.adapters.detect.validate_detection_thresholds after integer guards. Rust stops at that import and does not return ScanReport.
GAP-scan-safe-discriminator: resolve_cross_file_links and reconcile helpers call sesslint.adapters.safe_value.safe_discriminator. Rust stops at that seam.
GAP-scan-fingerprint: scan_single_source make_finding paths require sesslint.determinism.canonical_json_bytes for fingerprints. Rust propagates FINGERPRINT_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE instead of findings.
GAP-scan-json-loads: load_scan_schema on an existing schema file calls json.loads in Python. Rust stops with json.loads is not available.
